description: Create a Secure Note item in a 1Password vault, with optional tags and custom fields.

fields.description: Optional custom fields to attach to the note.

idOrTitle.description: Field id or title to create.

section.description: Optional section id to associate the field with.

type.description: Field type: 'text' for plain values, 'concealed' for secrets.

notes.description: Note body text. Pass an empty string for an empty note.

vaultId.description: Vault ID to create the note in.

name: note_create
